name: @objectstack/eslint-plugin
description: The four custom ESLint rules the root `eslint.config.mjs` registers for this repository's own code: slot-lookup, query-options, verify-stand-in and comment-swallow. Not published, no build step, plain ESM so `pnpm lint` loads it on every Node the repo supports. The root config imports the source path relatively, never this bare name.
author: ObjectStack
